column1: # bulk-shared-window.tsv -- which sessions a fleet bulk action (Approve all, Stop all, Nudge all) counts
# and acts on (2026-10-13). core.selectActionable (tests/core.test.lua) and the panel's twin
# actionableKeys (tests/bulk-actionable.test.js) both answer to this one table, so the number on the
# button is what the click does. A session whose VS Code window hosts others takes no keystrokes
# (core.handleAction refuses them), so only its headless actions count: an armed gate's decision file.
